negative_contract_policy: Unsigned/floating/128-bit coordinate instantiations must fail at static_assert in debug and release. Twelve out-of-bound x/y singleton/two-point/all-identical-three-point cases must abort in debug; none are executed in release. Valid two-point and all-identical-three-point exact-boundary controls must succeed. Expected rejection exit codes are recorded separately from status.
